title: NOMOS Execution Response
description: Response body from POST /api/v1/verify (§6.2) — the verdict returned after evaluating a decision context. NOMOS-SPEC-001 v2.0.0 corrected this to match the real response: v1.1.0 documented a verdict enum ('proceed'/'escalate'/'deny') and required fields ('request_id', 'ts', 'contradictions' as a count) that no real endpoint ever returned.

allowed.description: True only for an AUTHORIZED/auto_approved outcome.

outcome.description: The real verdict vocabulary — not 'proceed'/'escalate'/'deny' as v1.1.0 claimed.

rule_reference.description: ID of the primary rule that determined the outcome.

rule_description.description: Natural-language text of the matched rule, verbatim from the artifact.

matched_rules.description: IDs of all rules that matched the context.

artifact_id.description: ID of the artifact that was evaluated.

artifact_name.description: Human-readable name of the artifact that was evaluated.

audit_hash.description: Content hash of the verdict record — see the evaluator's own audit_hash field.

audit_record.description: Same value as audit_hash under a second key name — a real, harmless redundancy in the reference implementation, not two independent hashes.

contradictions.description: Always an empty array in the current reference implementation — reserved for future use, not a live contradiction count as v1.1.0 claimed.

reason.description: Present when verdict is 'escalate' due to a system condition rather than a rule match (e.g. 'missing_context_field', 'guard_constraint_violated', 'unknown_agent').

replay.description: Present and true when the execution used a caller-supplied execution_at timestamp. Absent on live executions. NOMOS-SPEC-003 §8.

execution_at.description: Echo of the execution_at value from the request. Present only when replay: true. NOMOS-SPEC-003 §8.

expired_rules.description: IDs of rules that were skipped due to temporal bounds at the execution instant. Present when at least one rule was expired. NOMOS-SPEC-003 §5.

max_age.description: RECOMMENDED maximum seconds a caller SHOULD hold this verdict before re-querying or re-checking the issuer's revocation list. Advisory, not required for conformance; absence is not an error. Distinct from staleness_advisory below (triangulation drift) — this reflects revocation risk. NOMOS-SPEC-006 §6.2.

staleness_advisory.description: Passive advisory emitted when decisions since last triangulation exceed the staleness threshold. Never affects verdict. NOMOS-SPEC-003 §6.

triangulated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last triangulation run.

decisions_since_triangulation.description: Number of executions against this artifact since the triangulation baseline was recorded.

threshold.description: The staleness threshold that was exceeded.

examples.rule_description: Automatic approval when credit_score >= 720 and income_to_repayment_ratio >= 2.5
examples.verdict_description: Rule "rule_005" matched. The authority permits this action.

examples.rule_description: Applications with credit_score < 720 require human officer review before approval
examples.verdict_description: Rule "rule_003" triggered. The authority requires human review before this action can proceed.
